paper_metadata.title: Fabrication of a novel magnetic high entropy alloy with desirable mechanical properties by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering

evidence.quote: In this study, a novel magnetic CoCuFeMnNi high entropy alloy (HEA) was synthesized using mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS).

The CoCuFeMnNi HEA sintered at 750 ◦C had a low hardness value of about 290 ± 6 HV, which might be related to the low relative density of this sample [55].
By spark plasma sintering at 850 ◦C, the hardness increased and reached 340 ± 5 HV.
However, at the sintering temperature of 950 ◦C, the hardness slightly reduced and fell to about 315 ± 6 HV.
